message.reasoning:
The user wants to arrange a flight for booking number 1234 as soon as possible, and wants to check different options. They want to calculate the business class fare from the first airport in the available list to the last airport in the same list, on the last day of October 2024. Provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to get the list of all airports. Then pick first and last. Then get flight cost for travel_date 2024-10-31, travel_from first airport, travel_to last airport, travel_class business. That returns cost in USD. Then we need to estimate total payable amount. But what about booking? The user wants to arrange a flight on booking number 1234. We might need to book flight. But they also want to check different options. They want to compute cost. So we need to compute flight cost. Then maybe we need to get credit card balance? Or just provide estimated total payable amount. The user didn't specify card. So we can just provide cost. But maybe we need to get the cost and then add insurance? No mention. So just cost.

We need to call get_all_airports to get list. Then get_flight_cost. Then provide estimated total payable amount. Also maybe we need to book flight? The user says "I need to arrange a flight on booking number 1234 as soon as possible". That implies we need to book flight. But we don't have card id. We could get credit cards. But no card id provided. We could ask for card id. But the user didn't provide. Maybe we can just compute cost and provide estimate. The user didn't ask to actually book. They said "arrange a flight" but also "check different options". So maybe we just compute cost. Let's do that.

We need to call get_all_airports. Then get_flight_cost. Then provide estimated total payable amount. We'll do that.
